name: Louis
description: Louis is an IT systems analyst and a caring member of the group who often tries to keep morale up.
biography: An IT Systems Analyst in Philadelphia with an MBA who practiced shooting during lunch breaks. Two days into the outbreak, he killed his first infected in the office restroom while believing the media was overreacting. He emerged to find his coworkers dead and the city in ruins. He is the most educated survivor, speaks Japanese, and frequently references video games.
occupation: IT Systems Manager at a large company
